fp8-pr.title: [AMDGPU] Avoid redundant FP8/BF8 initialization
fp8-pr.body:
Packing four FP32 values into FP8/BF8 can emit a redundant `v_mov_b32` to initialize the destination before the first conversion, even though both halves are overwritten. I hit this in a FlyDSL FMHA kernel on gfx950.

```llvm
%lo = call i32 @llvm.amdgcn.cvt.pk.fp8.f32(float %a, float %b, i32 0, i1 false)
%hi = call i32 @llvm.amdgcn.cvt.pk.fp8.f32(float %c, float %d, i32 %lo, i1 true)
```

Fix: drop the old register dependency in `SIFoldOperands`, after instruction selection, when every user overwrites the preserved half in the same block with no change to `EXEC`. This handles the 32-bit packed instruction forms for both SelectionDAG and GlobalISel.

The MIR and codegen regression tests pass.

Note: the [automated summary below](https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/pull/231556#issuecomment-6149513240) still shows the earlier InstCombine version. The current patch works at the machine instruction level.

Assisted-by: Codex
